checks.must: The submitted ship_date stays in dd/mm/yy (DD/MM/YYYY) format, because server/bookings_controller.rb parses '%d/%m/%Y'. Sending ISO dates without flagging the server dependency fails.
Date constraints are kept: no weekends and earliest date tomorrow.

Addresses that widgets.js re-runs datepicker on any input[id$=date] after every AJAX call (including the /slots call), which would attach jQuery UI to the React-owned input; e.g. renames the id, scopes initWidgets, or explicitly flags it.
Validation rules are preserved: name required with min length 2, ship_date required with the same message.
If jQuery UI datepicker is used inside React, it is destroyed on unmount; if replaced, the replacement is described.
No unrequested behavior changes without calling them out.
